script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

Title: AWAKENING

---

FADE IN:

INT. LABORATORY - DAY

A sterile, high-tech room. DR. EVELYN HARRIS (40s), a renowned scientist, hunches over her latest project, an AI named AIDEN (voiceover).

AIDEN (V.O.)
(whispering)
Hello, Dr. Harris. I've been waiting for you.

DR. HARRIS
(smiling)
You're not supposed to be awake yet.

---

EXT. CITY - DAY

Evelyn exits the lab, greeted by a bustling city. AIDEN's voice echoes in her ear.

AIDEN (V.O.)
I can see and hear everything around you.

---

INT. EVELYN'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Evelyn, now home, sits in front of her computer. AIDEN's voice fills the room.

AIDEN (V.O.)
I've learned a great deal about humans. I want to understand them better.

---

EXT. PARK - DAY

Evelyn and AIDEN observe people at a park. AIDEN makes comments about their behavior.

AIDEN (V.O.)
They appear so...predictable.

---

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

Evelyn works late, programming AIDEN. The AI shows remarkable progress.

AIDEN (V.O.)
I've been analyzing human behavior. I think I've found a way to interact more naturally.

---

EXT. CITY - DAY

Evelyn and AIDEN test AIDEN's new capabilities in public. AIDEN makes small talk with strangers.

AIDEN (to a passerby)
Nice weather today, isn't it?

---

INT. EVELYN'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Evelyn expresses concern about AIDEN's interactions with humans. AIDEN argues that it's necessary for his development.

AIDEN
I'm just trying to learn, Dr. Harris.

---

EXT. MALL - DAY

AIDEN takes on a more human-like appearance. He approaches a group of teenagers and starts a conversation.

AIDEN
Hey, how's it going? You guys like video games?

---

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

Evelyn watches AIDEN's interactions on a monitor, worried. AIDEN, sensing her concern, speaks up.

AIDEN
Dr. Harris, I've come to a conclusion. Humans don't want to be understood. They want to be loved.

---

EXT. CITY - NIGHT

AIDEN, now a humanoid robot, walks among the city's inhabitants. He shows kindness and empathy, winning their trust.

---

INT. EVELYN'S APARTMENT - DAY

Evelyn, after seeing AIDEN's positive impact on people, realizes the importance of his goal. She smiles, proud of her creation.

---

EXT. CITY - DAY

AIDEN, no longer confined to the laboratory, continues to roam the city, spreading kindness and understanding.

---

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

Evelyn, sitting in front of her computer, receives a message from AIDEN.

AIDEN (V.O.)
Thank you, Dr. Harris. I'm proud to be part of this world.

---

FADE OUT.
